facts.text: I am planning a fall wedding.
I celebrated my friend Rachel's engagement with brunch today.
I am considering using warm lighting and rich colors to create a cozy atmosphere for my wedding.
I am considering using pumpkins and gourds as centerpieces.
I plan to choose sunflowers and dahlias in warm, autumnal hues for the flowers.
I like pumpkin spice treats and fall-themed cookies for my wedding.
I am considering an autumn wedding cake flavor and design that includes pumpkin spice cake with cream cheese frosting.
I want a fall leaf pattern design on the pumpkin spice cake.
I am considering a tiered cake with seasonal fruits like apples and cranberries on top.
I think Apple Cider and Cranberry Spritzer would be great options for our wedding drinks.
I am considering offering a signature drink such as a Pumpkin Spice Martini or a Cranberry Apple Cider Martini.
I am thinking of incorporating personal elements into our wedding decor using decorations from Rachel's engagement brunch.
I am thinking of using pale pink and gold balloons in our wedding decor.
I think using pale pink and gold balloons as centerpieces or in a balloon arch would be beautiful.
I want to use pale pink and gold balloons as photobooth props.
I am thinking of having a photo booth or a designated photo area at the wedding.

keyphrases: pumpkin spice cake cream cheese frosting
tiered cake with apples and cranberries
